decisions.reason: The reporting dimensions and conversion metric do not change how enriched contacts are synchronized from Apollo to HubSpot.
Grouping a HubSpot report by Contact Source does not change the transfer of HubSpot lead lists into MeetAlfred.
The requested HubSpot funnel report does not alter the workflow for creating a MeetAlfred campaign and configuring its Zap.
The reporting change is unrelated to the campaign domain name, registrar, or domain-creation obligation.
The requested Contact Source funnel does not affect the deferred domain and email warm-up requirement.
The HubSpot reporting specification neither resumes nor changes the deferred LinkedIn campaign automation.
The funnel report requirements do not change the required MeetAlfred subscription plan or account setup.
The requested HubSpot report does not change the Zapier account requirement, subscription tier, or add-on configuration.
